subject: Minor u64 recover speedup
perf_evidence: Commit subject explicitly identifies a u64 recovery speedup.
change_summary: Rewrites the 128-by-128 quotient/remainder calculation used by unsigned-64 divisor recovery.

units.name: raw 128-by-128 high-remainder helper, unrestricted inputs
units.evidence: Alive2 finds high-remainder mismatches outside the documented 64-bit-quotient domain in both directions.

units.name: raw helper with nonzero denominator and 64-bit quotient precondition
units.evidence: Quotient and low remainder pass both directions; high remainder times out both directions.

units.name: public unsigned-64 branchfull and branchfree generator then recover
units.precondition: d != 0 for branchfull; d >= 2 for branchfree
units.evidence: Both public recovery targets time out in both directions at the 600-second SMT limit.

notes: The raw mismatch does not establish a public API mismatch: its example lies outside the helper's documented quotient-fit precondition. The public caller check remains inconclusive.
